{{Quote|Four on one is hardly a fair fight, even for a Jedi.|Rumi Paramita|<ref name="BH" />}}
'''Rumi Paramita''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Frenk/Legends|Frenk]] and a member of [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi's]] band of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] that were active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the war, she assisted in the defense of [[Casiss/Legends|Casiss']] farm against [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] pirate gang. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a cannon blast fired by [[Pikk Mukmuk/Legends|Pikk Mukmuk]] from Hondo's tank.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I seem to find myself light on company.|Sugi, after Paramita's death|<ref name="BH" />}}
[[File:Rumi_Paramita_blaster.png|thumb|left|220px|Rumi aiming her blaster at Weequay pirates]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> Rumi Paramita was a member of [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi's]] group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] when Casiss hired them to protect his farm against raids by the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]]. She was present when [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] came to the planet, and viewing them as a threat to her clients, was the first to sneak up on them and point her [[IQA-11 blaster rifle|rifle]] at the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. After some deliberation, however, the Jedi convinced the bounty hunters and their clients that they were not in league with the pirates. However, they made it clear that they couldn't help the village farmers.<ref name="BH" />

The [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] attacked on [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] bikes shortly afterward, and Kenobi was surprised to find that his prior acquaintance, [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], was the leader of the pirate gang. Reneging on their prior decision, the Jedi agreed to help the farmers by teaching them to defend themselves against the next raid. Paramita was not only instrumental in helping the villagers learn to fight, but also assisted with the harvest.

When the second attack came, Paramita was positioned on top of a building, giving her a clear line of fire to act as a sniper. During Ohnaka's duel with Skywalker, his pet, [[Pikk Mukmuk/Legends|Pikk Mukmuk]], fired the cannon of Ohnaka's [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|WLO-5 speeder tank]] at Paramita, blasting her off the roof and killing her.<ref name="answer" /><ref name="BH" />

==Skills and abilities==
Rumi was an expert sniper, being able to shoot a man off a fast-moving speeder bike. Her primary weapon was the [[IQA-11 blaster rifle]], though she carried a small blaster pistol as a back-up. She used her sniper skills to great effect in the skirmish on Felucia, killing a pirate on a speeder bike with a single shot. When Pikk Mukmuk fired a cannon blast at her, she attempted to make a run for it but was not swift enough and was killed by the blast.

==Behind the scenes==
Paramita was voiced in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Bounty Hunters (episode)|Bounty Hunters]]" by [[Anna Graves]], who also lent her voice to Sugi and [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. Although her death was not made explicit in the episode, it was confirmed by series director [[Dave Filoni]] in a video on the [[StarWars.com|official ''Star Wars'' site]].<ref name="answer" />

"[[Wikipedia:Pāramitā|Pāramitā]]" is a word meaning "perfection" or "completeness" in [[Wikipedia:Sanskrit|Sanskrit]]. In Buddhism, the ''pāramitās'' are the perfection of certain virtues by an individual as a means of purifying karma on the way to enlightenment.<ref name="Tucker">{{WebCite|url=http://dsalsrv02.uchicago.edu/cgi-bin/philologic/getobject.pl?c.3:1:4051.apte|text=''The Practical Sanskrit-English Dictionary''|work=Vaman Shivaram Apte|nobackup=1}}</ref>
